raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the new senior data engineer"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be on"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the risk team"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Cluj"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "come from"
      role subject ?x
      role source "Endava"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "arrive"
      role subject ?x
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  at "this month"
